schema.name: compounds
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE compounds (
    cn             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    example_smiles TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_path_id  TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: event_products
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE event_products (
    event_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    position       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_smiles TEXT NOT NULL,
    product_smiles_full TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, position)
)

schema.name: meta
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: path_instances
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE path_instances (
    path_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id    TEXT,
    event_id          TEXT,
    product_position  INTEGER,
    substrate_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
    status            TEXT NOT NULL,
    depth             INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status_reason     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    seq               INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: reaction_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reaction_events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    substrate_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_hash      TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind               TEXT NOT NULL,
    condition_fit      TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL, model_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, substrate_identity, evidence_id)
)
